data.long_meaning: The Arabic name Ghinaah is derived from the root word Ghanaa, which means 'to cover, to atone, to make up for a loss'. In Islamic belief, Ghinaah is the act of seeking forgiveness and making amends for past mistakes and sins. The name Ghinaah carries the meaning “Penance, Atonement” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghinaah usually hope their child will grow to embody penance, atonement and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to seek forgiveness and strive towards a righteous life.
data.etymology: Ghinaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Penance, Atonement.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghinaah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

The name Ghinaah is often given to girls in many Muslim cultures, and it is believed to bring good fortune and happiness to the bearer.
